notes: The input is the bytes of the body of one answer of attendance. params.status is the HTTP status of that answer.
params.family, params.session and params.start are the arguments of the entry point. The reader sends start only when it is more than 0.
value.request is the call that the reader makes: the path, and each parameter of the query as text. The reader sends its token in a header and never in the query.

value.entries is each entry of the answer that has a kind of the reader: user, agent, thought or tool_call. The text of a tool call is its result. value.unread has one sentence for each other entry that is an object.
The reader takes the first 500 items of the list and then drops each item that is no object. A text of an entry has 65536 characters or less. A title has 500 characters or less.
value.next_start is the next of the answer when it is an integer of 0 or more, and null for each other value. value.truncated is true only for the JSON true.
A field of a wrong type reads as an empty text, as 0, as false or as absent. A text has 500 characters or less. A character is one code point.
A refused vector is an answer that the reader gets nothing from. refusal is the problem that a page shows.

A problem is an object. class is one of none, missing, unreadable, too large, not JSON, not an object, refused, unreachable, not a record and capped. capped is a notice: the reader stopped at a limit and kept what it read before.

text is the sentence that a page shows. A problem of the class not JSON has no text: its sentence ends with a message of the JSON reader of Python. It has start, the part of the sentence before that message.
